title: Parallel Branches
blurb: Two subagents work at the same time on Branches of their own. The main agent publishes one; publish overwrites main, so it asks the other to merge main in first.

root.say: Two independent pieces: a header and a footer. Each subagent gets its own Branch.

subagent.prompt: Fork a header Branch from main, add app/header.tsx (the site header) with fs, test the Branch in a Workspace, and report the Branch and Commit.

root.note: Independent work gets its own Branch; both start from main's first Layer.

subagent.prompt: Fork a footer Branch from main, add app/footer.tsx (the site footer) with fs, test the Branch in a Workspace, and report the Branch and Commit.

root.reply: header and footer are working in parallel; I'll publish when they report.

root.say: Both are ready. Only I publish to main: header first.
root.note: main moves to a new Layer with the header.

root.say: main moved, and publish overwrites. footer must bring main in before I publish it.

send_message.message: I published header, so main moved. Merge main into a new footer-2 Branch and report it.

root.note: main has both changes, and nothing was overwritten.

root.reply: main has the header and the footer: header was published first, and footer merged main in before its publish.

header.say: Forking header and writing the component with fs; then a Workspace to test it.

bash.description: Fork header, write and test it

header.reply: Ready: Branch header, with app/header.tsx committed and the tests passing.

footer.say: Forking footer and writing the component with fs; then a Workspace to test it.

bash.description: Fork footer, write and test it

footer.reply: Ready: Branch footer, with app/footer.tsx committed and the tests passing.

footer.say: Merging main into footer-2; footer itself stays as it is.
footer.note: a + b = c: footer and main stay as they are; footer-2 holds both files.

footer.reply: Ready: Branch footer-2 holds the footer and main's header, with no conflicts.
